tinyusb_msc_storage: Failed to allocate memory for MSC storage

classification: Removing ESP-Hosted fixed the prior constructor-driven SDIO assertion and reduced the image by 256256 bytes. The controller-first storage path still incorrectly creates the TinyUSB MSC storage object during normal app ownership, making SD readiness depend on internal memory reserved for USB Host. Independently, one display refresh timeout after the long boot-audio sequence is escalated to a permanent dark halt even though display initialization and prior boot frames succeeded.
corrective_action: Split normal SD/VFS mounting from on-demand MSC object creation and deletion so controller mode pays no MSC allocation. Make boot-frame submission tolerate and report bounded transient refresh timeouts without blacking out or halting, while preserving fatal handling for initialization, invalid state, and allocation failures. Issue a new exact-artifact authorization only after focused tests and a clean build.
